build_notes.runtime_restart: A runtime restart at ~01:39 UTC 2026-11-20 wiped /tmp, losing the first parallel build's worker shards (~1,200 filings fetched). The edgartools cache (~/.edgar, 3.6 GB) survived, so the rebuild from cache took ~55 min in 4 parallel chunked workers. All worker dirs/logs now live under ~/workspace/trading-system/ (persistent), not /tmp.
build_notes.shard_sizes: 16 quarterly shards, 335 MB total; largest 32 MB (Q1 shards hold the 10-Ks). Quarterly, not half-year: the Git Data API rejects blobs above ~40 MB and a half-year shard runs ~48 MB; a 38.7 MB test blob succeeded, a 47.9 MB one failed with 422.
build_notes.stale_client: Long-lived edgartools processes degrade after ~15 tickers / ~250 requests (list calls start failing fast); fixed by running in fresh processes of <=8 tickers per chunk. No data was lost to this - failed tickers were re-run.

gap_fill_w4.blk_old_cik: BlackRock filed under CIK 1364742 until late 2024, then CIK 2012383 (current BLK mapping). Added the 7 pre-change filings (2023-02-24 10-K through 2024-08-06 10-Q) under BLK via EXTRA_CIKS in the builder. BLK now 16/16.
gap_fill_w4.mda_fallback: 30 records recovered MD&A via the regex fallback (mda_source=fallback): INTC 16 (all filings - edgartools misses Item 7 in Intel docs), PNC 10 (10-Q MD&A is headed 'Financial Review'), USB 3 (2023 10-Qs), MCD 1 (2023 10-K, both sections empty before fallback). Every recovered head/tail was eyeballed. Missing MD&A is now 0 across the dataset.
gap_fill_w4.unp_lin_retries: UNP and LIN each had 1 extraction failure in the chunked build (transient); retried in w4, both now 16/16, 0 failures.

gate.result: PASS - 2,108 records, 133/133 tickers, 0 validation errors, 130 holdout-window records
gate.rule: PASS iff every record passes schema + point-in-time validation, coverage >=95% of expected filings, every universe symbol has >=1 filing, and holdout-window filings exist

haiku_sample_validation.verdict: Excerpts are real filing text and Haiku scores them sensibly with rationales citing actual filing numbers. Dataset is ready for Phase 2 (exp-technical-plus-llm-v1).

known_gaps.manifest_failures_2: Historical log entries only (UNP + LIN extraction failures from the chunked build); both filings were recovered in the w4 gap-fill and are in the dataset.
known_gaps.mcd_10k_risk: MCD 2023-02-24 10-K risk factors still unparsed (edgartools section split fails on that document); MD&A recovered via fallback, so the record is valid.
known_gaps.missing_risk_185: Mostly 10-Qs (176) where Item 1A is legitimately omitted/short when unchanged; 4 in 10-Ks (3 HAL, 1 MCD). Stored empty + listed in missing_sections; never filled from another filing.
